name: Yuuki Nayuta
source:
Flaw: He does not communicate with others

‘………………………I have nothing to say.’

2nd year high-school student. Grew up in the same orphanage as his childhood friends, the heroine and [url=/c42614]Haruma[/url]. A dancer who can skilfully perform most genres of dance — the public has high hopes of him becoming a choreographer. However, though he has talent, he doesn’t have the motivation to do anything with it. 

[From [url=https://riebakkari.wordpress.com/2016/01/17/blackish-house-introduction-2/]Rie's Otoge Blog[/url]]
